final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format. For each entry, I extracted the service, level (upper case), message, and the last line of the traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service and wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json.
